messages.body_plain:
hi

Today I installed sqldf package to handle 2GB txt file. And I got an error message saying vimcom and tcltk packages are incompatible.

The installed tcltk package version is 3.1.1.
The installed vimcom package version is 1.0-0.
R version is 3.1.1

any idea? thanks a lot.

yuejun

messages.subject: Re: vimcom and tcltk packages are incompatible
messages.subject_clean: vimcom and tcltk packages are incompatible
messages.body_plain:
The incompatibility between vimcom and tcltk exists on Microsoft Windows. Sorry, but you can use both packages at the same time only on an Unix system (like Linux or Mac OS X).

Vimcom evaluates commands sent by Vim and these commands may be sent while R is busy doing something else. On Unix, the commands are not evaluated immediately: they are executed only when R becomes idle. However, I could not find equivalent code for Windows. One practical consequence is that R would crash if tcltk and vimcom are loaded at the same time and some of vimcom features were not disabled.

If you or someone else wants to improve vimcom code, please, start looking at flag_eval, vimcom_uih and vimcom_exec in src/vimcom.c to understanding what I have done so far.
